title: Width of a Tseitin clause term
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, and let $L$ and $A$ be lists of literals on $n$ coordinates. Suppose the coordinate indices in each list are pairwise distinct, the two lists have disjoint sets of coordinate indices, and $|L|\le |A|+3$. Every term in the Tseitin clause terms formed from $L$ and $A$ then has width at most $3$.
hypotheses_covered: The indices in the literal list $L$ are pairwise distinct
The indices in the auxiliary list $A$ are pairwise distinct
The indices in $L$ and $A$ are disjoint
The term belongs to the Tseitin clause terms formed from $L$ and $A$
